## Workshops {#workshops}

<p class="ghe-intro">Workshops taught by Lars Schöbitz, data steward of the group, newest first. Each card links to the material.</p>

```{r}
#| label: workshops
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

# The list comes from the aboutme package (github.com/larnsce/aboutme), the
# same source as the CV. Netlify does not run R: after a change to the
# workshops in aboutme, render this page locally and commit _freeze/index/.

workshops <- aboutme::entries
workshops <- workshops[workshops$section == "workshops", ]
workshops <- workshops[order(workshops$start, decreasing = TRUE), ]

# start is a year, a year and month, or a full date.
format_start <- function(x) {
  parts <- as.integer(strsplit(x, "-")[[1]])
  if (length(parts) == 1) return(as.character(parts))
  month <- month.name[parts[2]]
  if (length(parts) == 2) return(paste(month, parts[1]))
  paste(parts[3], month, parts[1])
}

escape <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("&", "&amp;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("<", "&lt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  gsub(">", "&gt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
}

card <- function(row) {
  place <- if (is.na(row$loc) || row$loc == "") "" else paste0(", ", row$loc)
  kicker <- paste0(format_start(row$start), place)
  body <- paste0(
    '<span class="ghe-card-kicker">', escape(kicker), "</span>",
    "<strong>", escape(row$title), "</strong>",
    '<p class="ghe-card-host">', escape(row$institution), "</p>",
    "<p>", escape(row$description_1), "</p>"
  )
  if (is.na(row$url) || row$url == "") {
    paste0('<div class="ghe-card">', body, "</div>")
  } else {
    paste0('<a class="ghe-card" href="', row$url, '">', body, "</a>")
  }
}

cards <- vapply(
  seq_len(nrow(workshops)),
  function(i) card(workshops[i, ]),
  character(1)
)

cat("```{=html}\n<div class=\"ghe-cards\">\n", paste(cards, collapse = "\n"), "\n</div>\n```\n", sep = "")
```
